description: Compare a loan with no discount points against the same loan at a reduced rate bought with points costing a percentage of the loan amount, and compute the monthly savings and the break-even month where cumulative savings recoup the points cost.

baseRatePercent.description: The loan's annual interest rate with no points, as a percent, e.g. 6.5

pointsCostPercent.description: Cost of the discount points, as a percent of the loan amount, e.g. 1 for one point

rateReductionPercent.description: How many percentage points the rate drops when the points are bought, e.g. 0.25

name: calculate_mortgage_points
